concept: To Make a Mixture from Two or More Things
question: In what ratio must a grocer mix two varieties of rice costing Rs. 128 and Rs. 143 per kg, respectively, to get a mixture of rice worth Rs. 137.75 per kg?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost of first variety of rice = Rs. 128 per kg.

Cost of second variety of rice = Rs. 143 per kg.

Cost of the mixture = Rs. 137.75 per kg.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c982e4c02fb3588f9b412e948cb0da0207b4794e147304b4f9694ed6ea4a257.png] 

Required ratio

⇒ 5.25 : 9.75

⇒ 525 : 975

⇒ 7 : 13

**∴ The grocer must mix the two varieties of rice in the ratio 7 : 13.**
